name: Elder Tanaka
source: Elder Tanaka is Millhaven's landlord and de facto village elder, based at the Traveler's Inn. He knew the protagonist's family and presents a patient, paternal face, but his warmth cools into calculation as rent debt and his cellar dealings come into play.
